networkIsolation.conclusion: SDK endpoints have distinct live tips and mutually absent tip coinbase transactions. Both nodes label their chain main; this field alone does not identify the SDK testnet.

finality.sourceOrigin: Official GitHub source, not the running remote node binary; runtime lock tests remain required.
finality.timestampConfirmationCondition: median time of the 11 ancestors ending at the confirming block parent > nLockTime
finality.nonFinalAcknowledgement: A broadcast acknowledgement may place the transaction in the separate non-final pool; ordinary mempool/raw API invisibility does not prove rejection.

indexerConclusion: After both first issuances were confirmed in block 832983, both Coin info endpoints still returned STABLECOIN_NOT_FOUND, balances were zero and UTXO lists empty. Current published stableCoin-specific indexes do not provide the new coins at the recorded observation times; raw transaction validation and accepted-only ledger remain available. Do not infer precise backend cause (unsupported template versus lag) without further server evidence.
